findings.evidence: Protocol text (homepage SOURCE 1, README SOURCE 3) publishes no release identifier for this board; README badge only states 'Tasks 40'. Criterion c2 requires version_status 'snapshot' when the page publishes no release identifier, but the row claims 'published' with version '40-tasks', which is not a maintainer-published release version.
findings.repair: Set version_status to 'snapshot' and version to 'snapshot-2026-11-11' (the capture date), or, if a published release identifier exists, cite it in the packet. Keep status:active since README news and SOURCE 4 (10 changed values today) show the board still reports results.

uncertainties: The raw leaderboard.json contents are not supplied verbatim, only generated summaries for the 'value' scale (21 values, min 12.41, max 21.12) and activity (10 changed rows); these are sufficient for the c1 scale and c2 active judgements but not for any other claim.

Interpretation of '40-tasks' as a published release identifier is not supported by the supplied protocol text; the maintainer publishes no version number, which is why version_status should be snapshot.
